items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And Morris French is on trombone. ... And those guys were great.

ctx.x: Oh, man. You could hear the guitar and bass, and we didn't use the piano. Mm-hmm. And what a band. And Buddy didn't blast. He played full trumpet. And Morris French is on trombone. Oh, man. I'm careful. You guys have always been talking about Morris French. Oh, he was trombone, man. And those guys were great. But now they're making how loud you can play. It's like, you know, it don't make sense. It's good for the public outside, you know, to come in. But music-wise...
You could hear the toilet, man. I'm telling you, man. They play so burned loud.
